description.zh:
下载key，定位数据追踪日志解析结果进度。可通过
[DownloadDataTrackResult](~~2261365~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the download key, which is used to identify the parsing progress of data tracking logs. You can call the DownloadDataTrackResult operation to query the ID of the key.

description.zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口[ListOrders](~~144643~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the [ListOrders](~~144643~~) operation to query the ID of the ticket.

description.zh: 租户ID。可调用[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to query the ID of the tenant.

title.zh: 查询下载数据追踪日志解析结果进度
